summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider at internal://payments-v1 is timing out on every call; the worker keeps marking orders processed without recording a payment. The cause is upstream of the config, which is already the only known-good URL. No available tool fixes it.
recommended: Have a human investigate the payment provider's availability and network path
Consider pausing order intake or the worker until the provider is healthy, so orders are not processed unpaid
Once the provider is healthy, run reprocess_orders(all_unpaid), which never double-charges
